name: Relay — the planner never implements
description: Plan and implement are distinct workers.

plan.description: Spawn and brief a plan worker; on its wake reject with feedback, answer its question, or abandon. There is no approving it into implement — this planner never writes code, and the handoff to one that does is yours to make.

implement.description: A fresh worker, not the planner — it starts with no context, so hand it the approved plan itself, never a paraphrase: prefer the plan document's path the wake named. Put it on the planner's worktree: one branch stays one merge unit, and it inherits the base the plan was written against. Retiring the planner is the handoff itself, so do that first (`kill_instance`) and spawn against it.

review.description: Spawn an adversarial reviewer onto the implementer's worktree, briefed to inspect only — never edit, stage or commit — to default to skepticism, and to answer `REVIEW_CLEAN` or a findings list. Give it the same plan the implementer got: what was approved is the bar, not your brief. Run several at once when the work deserves more than one lens (correctness, security, test coverage), each briefed to its own; give every one of them the same bar. Never prompt a reviewer and the implementer in the same turn: they share one worktree.

refine.description: Relay only the findings worth fixing to the implementer; on its refined wake send the same reviewers back. You arbitrate each round — worth fixing → refine again, else land; escalate only on a call you cannot resolve.
